_comment: Text substitutions applied before synthesis so place and nation names are spoken correctly (OpenAI and Gemini paths). Applied in order with a naive str.replace, so a longer name must precede any name it contains: 'My Cariboo Now' before 'Cariboo'. No hyphens, no ALL-CAPS, no spaces as syllable separators: OpenAI TTS reads hyphens as audible pauses and spaces as word gaps. Moved here from azure_tts.py on 2026-09-23.
